title: Total the minutes per owner
prompt: TaskItem and Sample are supplied. Write public static Dictionary<string, int> MinutesByOwner(List<TaskItem> tasks). For the tasks that are not done, return each owner with the total of their Minutes. An owner whose tasks are all done does not appear as a key.
hints: Which tasks count at all? Decide that before grouping.
Each owner needs one total, built from the Minutes of that owner's open tasks.
Filter with Where, group with GroupBy on Owner, then build the dictionary from each group's Key and its Sum of Minutes.
checkLabels: Ana's open tasks are 10 and 20 minutes, so her total must be 30.
Ben's one open task is 45 minutes.
Cy's only task is done, so Cy must not be a key.
The sample tasks must give exactly two owners.
An empty list must give an empty dictionary.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Includes the tasks that are already done.
Counts the tasks instead of adding their minutes.

feedback: Work out Ana's total by hand from the sample tasks, using only the tasks that are not done, and compare it with your result.
